subject: Fix buffered_reply assert in HFE commands with module keyspace notifications (#3743)
reason: The change adds initDeferredReplyBuffer/commitDeferredReplyBuffer around the reply-building in HGETDEL, the hexpireGenericCommand family, and HPERSIST (src/t_hash.c) to defer the array reply when a module blocks the client inside a keyspace-notification callback. Both helpers are strict no-ops unless a module is subscribed to keyspace events: initDeferredReplyBuffer returns immediately when moduleNotifyKeyspaceSubscribersCnt()==0, and the debugServerAssert in notify.c is satisfied by that same condition.
